regions.today: It will be a bright and chilly start to Monday, with frost and fog clearing. Cloud will increase during the morning and some patchy outbreaks of rain and drizzle will develop. Highs of 11 to 13 degrees in mostly light easterly winds.
regions.tonight: There will be further outbreaks of rain and drizzle on Monday night, but many parts will stay dry. Becoming cloudier overnight with rain moving into the southwest towards morning. Lows of 3 to 7 degrees in light to moderate winds.
regions.tomorrow: Generally dry at first on Tuesday morning, with some bright spells. However, rain will arrive in the afternoon and will continue through the evening. Highs of 11 to 14 degrees in light to moderate southeasterly winds.
